parsed.explanation: The dossier documents no trans-specific criminalisation, no border or document friction for visitors, and hate-crime and hate-speech protections covering gender identity since 2018–19 — a functioning-recourse signal in a strong rule-of-law state. The main traveller-facing negative is the 2025 swimming-pool changing-room restriction, but it is one private chain with legal contestation, not a universal state-imposed birth-sex facility rule with no remedy (well below the 0.35–0.45 tier-1 anchors). Clinical-access narrowing, LGR limits, and conversion-practice gaps are resident-facing climate signals, not visitor exposures. The 2019 'most LGBT-friendly destination' ranking and depathologisation corroborate an accepting climate; organised political opposition and harassment of advocates is hostile but not state-executed targeting. Known good evidence with one modest facility setback and open questions (changing-room scope, custody placement) sits in reduced risk, below the 0.85 anchors for verified protections.
